_about: SHELF of medieval Hebrew and Judeo-Arabic classics in English before 1931: Hartwig Hirschfeld's Kitab al Khazari of Judah Halevi (1905), Israel Zangwill's Selected Religious Poems of Solomon ibn Gabirol (1923), and Nina Salaman's Selected Poems of Jehudah Halevi (1924) and Songs of Exile (1901, as Nina Davis). Rodkinson's Talmud, Gorfinkle's Pirke Avot and Ginzberg's Legends of the Jews are on their own shelves; Maimonides's Guide and Bahya's Duties of the Heart are on others. Each title gates on its own translator. Printings before 1931 only. US public domain. Added 2026-10-17 by lane C (round 87); Adam may veto. No uids minted.
_name_words_note: Translator names only: fetch_shelf.py treats them as the identity check. Bare 'davis' is left out as a common surname.
_surname_note: Per title: the translator's name forms.
